<rect class="box" x="64" y="113" width="470" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="138" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">個々の Concrete スキーマの文書（欄 ・ rule ・ glossary の term</text>

<text class="label" x="74" y="236" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">x-relationship で指される欄の形）</text>

<rect class="box" x="780" y="194" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="219" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">その文脈だけ。版は並べて出し、</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="236" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">出した版は変えない</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="258" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>

<text class="label" x="74" y="283" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">glossary ・ instance ・ 判定の記録（記録の形は Abstract の一員）</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="258" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="283" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">文脈</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="258" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="283" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">文脈。人の判定は人が出した変更</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="300" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">でだけ</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="322" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>

<rect class="box" x="542" y="322" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="347" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Core</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="322" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="347" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Core だけ（実装の言語は契約に</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="364" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">出さない）</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="386" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="411" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">6</text>

<text class="label" x="74" y="411" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete が足した x- の意味の検証と、その依存</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="386" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="411" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Concrete（文脈）</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="386" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="411" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">その文脈。Core</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="428" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">は作法だけを持つ</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="450" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="475" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">7</text>
<rect class="box" x="64" y="450" width="470" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="475" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">変更の記録（意図 ・ 目的の参照 ・ 書いた者の種類 ・ 変更の項目 ・</text>
<text class="label" x="74" y="492" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">置き換える意図の id。セッション ID は持たない。形は Abstract の一員）</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="450" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="475" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">文脈</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="450" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="475" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">その文脈。書くのは変更を出した</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="492" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">作者か AI の Agent</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="514" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="539" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">8</text>
<rect class="box" x="64" y="514" width="470" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="539" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">目的（ACDR ・ 論点など）</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="514" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="539" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="514" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="539" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外。Core は目的の参照（id）</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="556" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">だけを持つ</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="578" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="603" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">9</text>
<rect class="box" x="64" y="578" width="470" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="603" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">ファイルの差分（前後の値）・ 履歴 ・ 出した者 ・ 時刻 ・ 承認 ・</text>
<text class="label" x="74" y="620" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">取り込み ・ 衝突</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="578" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="603" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外（AI のツール ・ harness ・</text>
<text class="label" x="552" y="620" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Git などの変更の仕組み）</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="578" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="603" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外。Core は差分を作らず受け取る</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="620" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">だけで、承認の記録を持たない</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="642" width="40" height="92" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="667" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">10</text>
<rect class="box" x="64" y="642" width="470" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="667" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">セッションの中身（会話の記録）</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="642" width="230" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="667" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外（手元の AI のツール）</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="642" width="220" height="92" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="667" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外。リポジトリに入れない。</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="684" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">セッション ID はセッションと</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="701" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">手元の索引にだけ置き、</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="718" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">変更の記録には入れない</text>
<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="740" width="40" height="75" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="765" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">11</text>
<rect class="box" x="64" y="740" width="470" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="765" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">セッションの発行と会話の中身 ・ AI ツールの起動</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="740" width="230" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="765" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外（AI ツール ・ 人 ・</text>
<text class="label" x="552" y="782" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">harness）</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="740" width="220" height="75" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="765" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">外。Core は起動の前に</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="782" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">問われて、再開する ID か</text>

<rect class="box focus" x="16" y="821" width="40" height="58" fill="#D5E6E3" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="2" rx="5"/>
<text class="title" x="26" y="846" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#111D1A">12</text>
<rect class="box" x="64" y="821" width="470" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="74" y="846" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">セッション（6つの欄。形は Abstract の一員）</text>
<rect class="box" x="542" y="821" width="230" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="552" y="846" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Core（作業した人の手元、</text>
<text class="label" x="552" y="863" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">コミットしない）</text>
<rect class="box" x="780" y="821" width="220" height="58" fill="#F3F7F5" stroke="#0D5C55" stroke-width="1.5" rx="5"/>
<text class="label" x="790" y="846" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">Core のコマンド（立てる ・</text>
<text class="label" x="790" y="863" font-family="Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#111D1A">閉じる）だけ</text>
